changelog: - **SaleVali Marketing CRM tables land in the shared schema** (APP_PRODUCT=marketing). Eight new models — `Customer`, `Contact`, `CustomerIntegration`, `Campaign`, `Interaction`, `Task`, `StageChange`, `TrialReminder` — plus nine enums, all additive: the diff is `CREATE TABLE`/`CREATE INDEX` only, so `prisma db push` cannot touch a live internship row. `Customer`/`Contact`/`Campaign`/`Task` carry a required `orgId` (born scoped, like `Tag` and `Requisition`); the rest are reached through their customer. `Customer.companyId` is an optional `SetNull` link to `Company`, so a firm that is both a staj veren firma and a SaleVali merchant can be shown as one. Marketing's `InteractionType` is ported as a separate `MarketingInteractionType` — re-casing the live `InteractionType` would rewrite every `InteractionLog` row. `Role` gains `MARKETING_ADMIN`/`MARKETING_MANAGER`/`MARKETER` (an enum widening `infra/schema-guard.sh` clears explicitly) rather than reusing `ADMIN`, which 115 files gate on. Every `createdBy` FK is nullable + `SetNull`, not Marketing's required + `Restrict`, so GDPR erasure (`hardDeleteUser`) keeps working. `scripts/sanitize-db.mjs` scrubs the new tables' PII. No application surface yet — schema and its guards only.
